services.name: Pontoon rental
services.desc: Explore North Florida’s iconic St. Johns River with St. Johns Watersports aboard our Godfrey Sweetwater pontoon boats - the perfect choice for relaxed cruising, swimming stops, and all-day river adventures. Designed for comfort and stability, our pontoons offer plenty of room to spread out, making them ideal for families, groups, and anyone looking to enjoy the river at their own pace. Launch into calm waterways, spot local wildlife, tie up at your favorite sandbar, or simply enjoy the breeze as you cruise through one of Florida’s most scenic river systems. blurb: Guests rent Jet Skis or pontoon boats to cruise the St. Johns River and Silver Glen Springs without guides or limits. Jet Skis can reach speeds up to 55 MPH and accommodate up to three riders with a combined weight limit of 530 lbs. Pontoon boats accommodate up to 11 passengers for cruising, swimming, and wildlife spotting.
